result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both pages take nearly the same approach: a cream paper card, a literary serif paired with a monospace, timestamped playlists and a wave divider. Neither looks like a generic dark-mode template, but both read more as daytime paper than after midnight. B edges ahead because its roman 'Low Tide' over a rust italic 'Radio' gives the title more presence, and its plain card is cleaner than A's ruled-notebook background effect. The 'Listen live' button is cut off in both screenshots, so neither one's label could be checked against its type system. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both pages use the same approach: a cream paper card with a serif plus a monospace, and neither looks like a generic dark-mode music page. B separates artist from track more clearly, with italic quoted titles over letterspaced caps for artists, and its log-book ruling and spaced 'RADIO' feel more analog. Neither page reads strongly as after-midnight on its light ground. The 'Listen live' button is cut off in both screenshots: barely visible in B and not visible at all in A, so I couldn't fully check item 5 for either.
